resolvedQuestions.answer: Create path = createBlankEntry → loadNewRecordTemplate → buildCreateEntryPlan → planCreateEntry → createNote. Template auto-applied when database.newRecordTemplate configured. No second engine needed.
Toolbar = ToolbarRenderer.renderNewButton (2 render sites at lines 236, 282). Row-menu = RowMenu.show. ≤2 new call sites, within 1-3 budget.
confirmWithModal exists in views/modals/ConfirmModal.ts, mobile-safe (extends Modal), used by RowMenu for delete. REQ-004 needs zero new modal code.

AppFlowy = no record-template concept (GridAddRowButton footer, RowService.createRow, no template param). Anytype = rich: per-view defaultTemplateId, MenuTemplateList picker, dedicated template button adjacent to add-row (controls.tsx:750-760).

Notion = blue New button with dropdown arrow at top-right. Click New = new page (default template if set). Click dropdown = template picker. Per-database templates. Repeating templates & database buttons are OUT of scope.

Empty/zero templates → dropdown hidden, main New does blank create. Deleted template → existing Notice error, no write. Concurrent clicks → existing suppressNextCreate/hasActiveOverlay guard. iCloud → one createNote per click. Mobile → Menu + ConfirmModal mobile-safe.

Module = src/data/TemplateToolbarAction.ts (pure functions, EuroFormat shape). 2 call sites (toolbar split-button + row-menu item) + wiring in DatabaseView. 4 new i18n keys. skipTemplate deferred. Optional confirm via confirmWithModal.
